name: Rare Michigan | No Bake
description: No Bake: This strain is designed for an ultra relaxing, delightful experience. Its buds, sticky and dank, promise a smooth and uplifting high. This strain doesn’t just boast high potency; it's an invitation to kick back and enjoy a tranquil high with rich tasting terps. Embrace the nostalgia and warmth of No Bake.
